jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description:
**United Kingdom, Aberdeen**
----------------------------

Apply Now **Job Title**
**Field Engineer Trainee (****Completions \& Well Intervention)**  

**About Us**
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. At SLB we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. We are facing the world’s greatest balancing act\- how to simultaneously reduce emissions and meet the world’s growing energy demands. Our collective future depends on decarbonizing the fossil fuel industry, while innovating a new energy landscape. It’s what drives us. Ensuring progress for people and the planet, on the journey to net zero and beyond.  

More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!  

Aberdeen  

**Job Summary**
Field Engineer Trainees play a crucial role in our company’s growth by developing into future technical specialists, managers and leaders. This position provides the opportunity to build expertise in product knowledge, leadership, customer interaction and the delivery of engineering services accurately, safely and efficiently. As a Field Engineer Trainee, you will have opportunities to work towards professional membership with a relevant engineering institution. You will learn the business from the ground up, gaining the knowledge, skills and experience needed to become a skilled and confident specialist in your field.  

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing area of the business, supporting **Completions \& Well Intervention (CWI)** activities. You will join a small, collaborative team and undertake a structured training programme designed to develop your technical knowledge, field experience, customer\-facing skills and engineering capabilities. As you progress through your development and achieve the required technical competencies, you will have the opportunity to progress into a specialised CWI Engineering role, providing engineering and operational support for completion and well intervention activities.  

**Essential Responsibilities and Duties**
During the training program, your responsibilities will include:
* Ensure job deliverables are accurate and delivered on time.
* Supporting the planning and execution of completion, workover and well intervention operations.
* Supporting the preparation and review of Authorisations for Expenditure (AFEs)
* Develop an understanding of well integrity, well barriers, pressure control and applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
* Execute service delivery to the customer.
* Participate in job risk analysis and continual improvement programs.
* Develop customer contacts to promote company products and services.
* Ensure company and regulatory standard compliance by implementing the Compliance Assessment Tool (CAT), self\-assessments, and well site inspections.
* Participate in HSE and Quality initiatives.
* Wear PPE and observe HSE policies.
* Maintain the required safety training.
  

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Engineering. Candidates with degrees in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Petroleum, Process Engineering are particularly encouraged to apply.
* Be globally mobile.
* Willingness and ability to work in a field\-based and operational environment.
* The desire to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic business on high\-value, technically complex products/projects.
* The right to work in the United Kingdom.
  

**Preferred Skills**
* Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly and confidently.
* Be able to choose and initiate action.
* Be passionate about learning and research.
* Be eager to deliver results and meet demands.
* Remain positive during pressures, setbacks, and fast\-paced environments.
  

If this role is of interest to you and you are eager to learn more then we strongly encourage you to apply. We can then discuss how you will help shape and grow SLB moving forward  

**Why, as a graduate, should you join us**
* **Dynamic work environments**

The strength of our culture means you’ll work in a fast\-paced, supportive work environment. We offer hybrid working with a combination of on\-site \& home working days to achieve the right work\-life balance and allotted time for participating in volunteering and sustainability efforts.
* **Developing future leaders**

Become part of a community where your potential to lead is nurtured from the start. Joining us opens doors to leadership opportunities within our organization and across the broader industry, as evidenced by over 90% of our executive team who began their careers with us.
* **Borderless careers**

Our career\-building approach means you’ll have dedicated systems and an open, honest dialogue with managers and HR, helping you develop your career with potential opportunities across regions, functions and businesses.
* **Women in STEM**

Diversity is a key part of our success, and we have focused on gender balance for nearly 25 years. We are dedicated to nurturing and developing female talent both locally and globally. To support this goal, SLB has several initiatives, including mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company\-wide webinars, all aimed at helping women succeed.
* **Industry\-Leading Equipment**

Engage with cutting\-edge technology positioned at the forefront of the industry, contributing to pioneering advancements.  

**Benefits:**
* Competitive salary.
* We offer private healthcare for employees and their families as well as subsidised dental care.
* We provide well\-being programs such as Employee Mental health support and health and wellness coaching.
* Generous private employee\-funded pension contributions.
* Income protection scheme and life insurance.
* Cycle to work scheme.
* We have multiple internal employee resources groups, female mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company\-wide webinars, amongst other opportunities.

Other benefits are also available through the SLB flexible benefits program.  

**Flexible working**
We are open to flexible, hybrid working with a combination of on\-site \& home working days.  

**Certifications and Awards**
* We are proudly recognized as a disability\-confident, committed level employer.
* The Disability Equality Index awarded us the title of "Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion" in 2023\.
* Ranked among LinkedIn's "top companies in the UK for career development" for 2024\.
* Proud members of Business Disability Inn and the Valuable 500 initiative.
* Proudly ranked 4\.3 out of 5 on Glassdoor for Equality, Diversity and Inclusion.
* Proudly ranked 4\.1 out of 5 on Glassdoor for overall employee benefits.
* Proudly ranked 4\.2 out of 5 overall on Indeed.
  

**Still want to know more about SLB?**
Why not follow some of these useful links below to learn more about us directly from some of our employees?
* **Our People \- hear our stories**
* **Our Stories \- women in STEM**
  

*SLB is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or other characteristics protected by law. \#SLB*
 **Benefits**
------------

### **International Opportunities**


Global adventure, broad exposure, and limitless learning await you. You'll be part of the most multi\-cultural and diverse team of experts in any industry, anywhere.


### **Insurance**


Health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents available from day one.


### **Learning Opportunities**


Global adventure, broad exposure, and limitless learning await you. You'll be part of the most multi\-cultural and diverse team of experts in any industry, anywhere.


### **Diverse and Inclusive**


Our exceptional and diverse people are the pulse and spirit of who we are. Every day, you will enrich your knowledge in an environment where differences in thought, creativity and experiences are embraced.


**About Us**
------------


We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.


Global in outlook, local in practice – and with a united, shared passion for discovering solutions, we hire talented, driven people and support them to succeed, personally and professionally.

  

  

SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.


We will endeavor to make a reasonable accommodation / modification to the known physical or mental limitations of a qualified applicant with a disability to assist in the hiring process, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local law. If you believe you require such assistance to complete this form or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodationhotline@slb.com to request assistance. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to.


SLB is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor\- priority referral Protected Veterans requested.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**\*\*This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have the unrestricted right to work in the UK to be considered\*\***

**Overview**

You’ll be a senior member of the Engineering Reliability Team that will work closely with Zen’s development, engineering, and operations centre teams. You’ll Work alongside the Development and engineering teams, to support, maintain, and consistently improve the development estate so the development teams can focus and innovate constantly to drive Zen’s business and the teams’ priorities.

Reporting to the DevOps team manager, you must have an excellent track record in DevOps roles and the drive and attitude to succeed. Zen are committed to investing in and developing you – we believe that everyone can lead and the way we do has a huge impact on our people and play a vital part in our success.

The DevOps team will be responsible for the design and implementation of applications' build, release, deployment and configuration activities. Other responsibilities include working within multi\-functional teams to gather requirements, evaluate tools, implementing/updating solutions, building and executing test plans, provision environments, application performance reviews, assist migration of Legacy systems, and triaging and fixing operational issues.

You’ll ensure incidents are run smoothly and ensure that operational knowledge is available and shared. As a senior you will be a point of escalation, demonstrating problem solving skills, the ability to learn quickly and adapt your skills and knowledge.

As a service provider we operate many technologies, so you’ll have the skills to work with experienced Lead DevOps engineers, Systems Engineers and developers leveraging frameworks, standards, and defined operational process to make the unfamiliar comfortable and familiar. Over time we’ll increasingly leverage SRE principles to further optimize and enhance capabilities – it’s a great opportunity to get in at the start and shape this journey.

**Objectives**

* Deliver continuous incremental improvement of systems and infrastructure
* Take end to end ownership and responsibility for development infrastructure and systems
* Be a technical escalation point and eventually be part of a 24/7 escalation rota
* Document as you go – enough so your colleagues can follow what’s been done and why
* Drive tasks forward with energy and enthusiasm
* Create proactive monitoring solutions using standard tooling \- mainly Zabbix and Elastic
* Conduct RCA (Root Cause Analysis) for incidents
* Develop standard operational procedures and documentation
* Develop and maintain self\-managing infrastructure services and dashboards.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities
* Provide advice on DevOps standards and practices

· Provide coaching and mentoring to Software and DevOps Engineer peers

**Key Responsibilities**

**Experience**

· Worked and succeeded as a DevOps Engineer

· Ideally, experience working in an ISP, Telco or other Managed Services environment or able to demonstrate experience in a complex heterogeneous environment

· Strong adaptable scripting experience – ideally C\#/JavaScript/typescript/.Net

· Comfortable working with automation tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab, Puppet)

· Worked in complex networking and firewall environments

· Production use of multiple AWS capabilities and Kubernetes debugging

· Demonstratable experience in dealing with technical debt effectively

· Comfortable working with SRE principles and lean methodologies

**Skills \- Essential**

* Very strong problem\-solving skills are essential – understanding of DevOps and SRE concepts with the ability to apply key techniques to unfamiliar problems
* Ability to influence others in matters of standards and best practice, especially individuals outside of our team
* Comfortable working with automation tools (Puppet, Git) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) with complex integrations and test frameworks
* Experience using containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes etc)
* Comfortable with Elasticsearch log standardisation, Kibana dashboard creation and data analysis skills
* Able to code to a good level \- this isn’t a developer role but you need scripting skills to succeed
* AWS hands on – Cloud formation, Route53, S3, DynamoDB, Cloud\-watch, Lambda, Security, and troubleshooting
* Certificate management and automation
* Strong troubleshooting and diagnosis skills
* Able to write documentation that covers what your peers and operations need to know
* Knowledge of Database systems and models
* Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS and Linux

**Interpersonal Skills**

We value interpersonal skills and responsible teamwork. You should be able to:

* Patient \& friendly with excellent interpersonal skills \- demonstrate a natural aptitude for dealing with people
* Influence and lead
* Strong attention to detail
* Happy working and supporting a small closeknit team
* Take and give feedback to tune future actions and behaviours
* Embrace and demonstrate Zen values
* Be kind, understanding, and listen to others
* Be organized

**Impact You'll Make**

You will be influencing and contributing to Zen’s long\-term goals and joining a family that believes business should be a force for good. We’re a company committed to improving the lives of our people, creating a better future through our community and charity work, and ensuring that we look after our environment.

Perhaps that’s why we’re officially a Great Place to Work and have achieved Carbon Neutral Plus status and B Corp Certification!

Pay: £58,000\.00\-£66,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Bereavement leave
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Employee mentoring programme
* Enhanced maternity leave
* Free parking
* Life insurance
* Paid volunteer time
* Sick pay
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Innovation Developer
jobs.description:
Higher education is undergoing a revolution, and Lancaster University is helping to lead it. As one of the world’s top universities, we have a strong tradition of innovation, and our future will be shaped by the opportunities created by new technologies.


Information Systems Services is seeking a Developer to join our Innovation Team.


Digital innovation is at the heart of our strategy and ambition. In the Innovation Team, we are focused on developing new ways of delivering the best experience possible for all our students and staff, whether they are based at our green Campus or located at home, wherever that may be in the world. Joining us is your chance to help lead the transformation.


**The Opportunity**


We are searching for a developer, to play a role in our creative and forward\-thinking team. The main purpose of this role is to be a developer throughout the full development stack on our innovation and mobile solutions. You will need to work with cloud and on\-premise development tools and framework, be able to mentor temporary staff in best practice and be willing to work across a range of emerging frameworks.


**What you will need**


You must have experience in programming languages and frameworks of C\# and React and have some experience of working with AWS and Azure. Experience of GIT for source code management and revision control.


Please refer to the included job description and person specification for further details of essential and desirable qualifications for the role.


The role is primarily based on the Lancaster University Bailrigg campus, with flexible hybrid working options to support a positive work\-life balance. We would expect a minimum of 3 days a week in the office, working flexibly to adapt to the needs of the role.


**So why us?**


You would be joining an agile, innovative team working to provide applications and services which have high impact and visibility. We are committed to supporting our new team members including students and have built an environment that fosters knowledge sharing and consideration of others.


This is a great opportunity for an experienced developer to have a transformative impact on the student experience of digital learning and further their own career with a global leader in Higher Education.


Please contact Brian Green (brian.green@lancaster.ac.uk), Head of Innovation and Mobile Development, if you have any questions and would like to informally discuss the role.

jobs.title: Graduate Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
**Ready to launch your career?**

  

Join Amey and **start building a career with real impact.**

  

We are excited to offer a fantastic opportunity for a Civil Engineer Graduate to join our NMC NE team based in Perth. Whether you are finishing university or looking for the next step in your career, this is a great place to develop your skills, confidence and future career.

 **Starting Salary:** £30,000\.00 per annum (Subject to review)

**Location****:** Caledonian House, West Kinfauns, Perth. PH2 7XZ

**Working hours per week:** Monday to Friday, 9\.00 am to 5\.00 pm, 40 hours per week.

**Start date****:** July 2027

  

Our two\-year Graduate Pathway will challenge and inspire you to reach your full potential and build your career, with a guaranteed permanent position to transition into on completion. Throughout the pathway, you will receive first\-class mentoring and structured learning and development to support your professional and personal growth. We will also contribute towards a relevant professional qualification.

 **About the team:**


Join our supportive and inclusive team within NMC NE, where you will work on projects that make a real difference to communities across the UK.


Amey is working in partnership with Transport Scotland Northeast since August 2022, with an increased focus on supporting the creation of sustainable futures for communities, together we will achieve net zero targets and improve the customer experience. Covering 593Km of network, we provide routine highways, bridges and structure maintenance as well as designing and managing road safety schemes. By ensuring our roads and highways are well\-maintained through all\-weather seasons and traffic incidents, we aim to create well\-functioning, safe spaces which minimise disruption, keep people moving and support thriving communities.

 **What you will do:**

* Plan and undertake specialist investigations.
* Assist with preparing technical documents and reports.
* Maintain high technical standards consistent with the project scope/brief.
* Provide design and specialist advice in relevant specialisms, e.g. pavements.
* Use of Transport Scotland’s Asset Management Performance System (AMPS) for scheme identification, development and recording of maintenance intervention.
* Assist the project manager with project related correspondence from internal and external stakeholders.
* Assist the project manager with Technical Workshops to discuss complex schemes and treatment proposals.
* Ensure compliance with relevant Health and Safety Legislation (CDM2015\).
* Ensure compliance at all times with the operating company's management system.
 **What you will bring:**


We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, keen to learn and ready to develop their career within a supportive and collaborative team.

* Minimum 2:2 degree in Civil Engineering.
* Full UK driving licence.
  

Behavioural competencies

* Passion for developing your skills, both professionally and personally.
* Enthusiasm for being part of a high\-performing team and a drive for success.
  

Please note that successful applicants will be required to undergo drug and alcohol testing, in line with our commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant working environment.


Please upload your certificates, predicted grades or achieved qualifications with your application, as this information will be used during shortlisting. Any offer of employment is conditional upon meeting the required academic criteria. If you experience any issues uploading documents, please contact our People Services team.

 **Why join Amey?**


At Amey, we work on long\-term stable contracts so you can plan a long\-term career with us. We have been awarded Platinum status by Investors in People which underscores our commitment to supporting our people across every part of our organisation, enabling them to shine. Whether you are starting your career, returning to the workplace or can bring your professional expertise and skills, there is a place for you here.


Our benefits are designed to help you thrive at work and in your home life. You will have the flexibility to choose benefits and development opportunities that are best for you.

* **Salary and rewards:**Enjoy a competitive annual salary with the potential for yearly reviews to ensure you are rewarded for your contributions
* **All\-round suppor**t: You will be supported throughout your graduate pathway by your manager, mentor, Early Careers team and wider graduate network
* **Career Growth:** Throughout your graduate pathway, you will receive first\-class mentoring and a structured learning and development pathway to enable your professional and personal development.
* **Training Opportunities:**Unlock your potential with comprehensive training, including fully funded leadership programmes tailored to your personal growth
* **Career pathways:** Your graduate pathway can open the door to future opportunities across Amey, helping you build a long\-term career after your pathway
* **Holidays:** Enjoy 24 days leave plus bank holidays and the opportunity to buy more
* **Pension:** Generous pension scheme, with extra contributions from Amey
* **Flexible working:** Work\-life balance and flexibility are key for our success. We empower our people to make choices that are right for them, with hybrid, part\-time and flexible work patterns open for discussion
* **Flexible benefits:** Customise your benefits with options such as insurance benefits, Cycle2Work scheme and access to discounted gym membership
* **Exclusive Discounts** **:** Access our online portal filled with discounts from leading retailers, healthcare services, and more, helping you save on the things that matter
* **Social Value: Y**ou will get two Social Impact Days each year to volunteer for a charity of your choice and further opportunities to support fundraising initiatives and, where eligible, participate in the Duke of Edinburgh Gold Award
* **Family friendly policies** for new parents or if you provide care for a dependant
* **Membership of our Affinity Networks**who connect, support and inspire diverse communities within Amey
 **About Amey**


Amey is a global, integrated infrastructure consultancy and operations partner. We design, deliver, protect, and maintain critical assets and systems.

  

  

We advise, design, finance, deliver, and enhance civic, transport, and defence systems. By combining strategic intelligence, engineering, infrastructure finance, and operational expertise, we create secure, resilient, compliant, and high\-value outcomes across the lifecycles of new and legacy assets.

  

What truly defines Amey is our commitment to people. Our business is only as strong as the individuals who power it, and our greatest asset is our team. If you're ready to learn, grow and start building a career with real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

  

  

To find out more take a look at our website Early careers \| Amey

 **Application Guidance and Diversity \& Inclusion**


At Amey we constantly evolve how we work to reflect the different needs and backgrounds of our employees. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age. We believe everyone deserves an opportunity to shine.

  

As a disability confident leader, we’re proud to guarantee applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role.

  

Please contact our recruitment team at peopleservices@amey.co.uk to discuss any access needs, reasonable adjustments or additional support that you may require at any point during the recruitment process.

  

Apply today. We are excited to hear from you!

  

\*\*\*We may close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications. Please apply as soon as possible\*\*\*

  

\#CVL


\#LI\-KC1

We are a fast\-moving technology company, and **one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world.** We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build **workplace technology** that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, **we need brilliant people** on board and that’s where you come in.

Our Engineering department is building out a brand new team to focus on how we scale our platform and onboard customers, with this role being a key part of that team. This is an ideal opportunity to have real impact and learn from a super talented team of Senior Engineers working alongside you.

  

Please note we are unable to offer visa sponsorship and require to people to be based in the UK or Ireland for this position

**Great benefits:**


£60,000\-75,000


Tech setup of your choice (MacBook Pro or equivalent, monitors, etc.)


£/€800 annual learning budget, plus two hours per week as ‘Focus Fridays’.

Your birthday off

* Work effectively with remote teams, including engineers from Java Spring Boot backgrounds, to deliver cohesive solutions.

* Use and help evolve our AI assisted development practices as part of Benifex's AI first SDLC.
* **Tech stack:** .NET, SQL, GCP, MSMQ (moving to Google Pub/Sub), Kubernetes

**What are we looking for?**

* Solid commercial experience in backend development with C\#.NET and .NET Core, and confidence working with SQL.
* A track record of delivering features end\-to\-end. You make steady progress without needing constant direction, unblock yourself where you can, and know when to ask for help.
* Good instincts for clean, maintainable code and awareness of non\-functional concerns like performance, security and testability.
* Comfortable debugging and diagnosing issues in a running system, and interested in understanding how things behave in production.
* Exposure to containerisation and CI/CD pipelines; you don't need to have owned them, but you should be able to work within them and want to go deeper.
* Awareness of modern architectural patterns such as microservices and event\-driven systems.

jobs.title: Sr. Electrical Engineer, Sustainability Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Sustainability Engineering team is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to drive the definition, development, and continuous improvement of electrical infrastructure standards across Amazon facilities in Europe.  

  

You will join a team which:  

* Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review
* Develops grid infrastructure standards spanning high\-voltage up to 24 kV (HV) and low\-voltage (LV) systems, ensuring a coordinated and resilient approach to grid design
* Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
* Drives end\-to\-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
* Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
* Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

  

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona  

  

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net\-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders
* Perform design validation and review to ensure compliance with established electrical standards during installation and commissioning of infrastructure
* Act as subject matter expert (SME) for LV and HV (up to 24kV) electrical systems
* Align stakeholder expectations and define technical requirements for EV charging network infrastructure and smart grid deployments
* Drive the technology roadmap for electrical infrastructure, including EV chargers, substations, energy efficiency solutions, and IoT technologies (e.g. smart metres)
* Develop business cases and present recommendations to leadership to secure approval for programme scoping and investment decisions
* Coordinate with programme managers to ensure quality and standards compliance across large\-scale installations
* Drive process improvement across commissioning, audit, value engineering, and cost control activities

  

A day in the life  

Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organisation and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short\-, mid\-, and long\-term technical decisions with large\-scale impact across the Amazon network. You will also work with partners from Operations, Reliability \& Maintenance, Health and Safety, Global Fleet Product, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to design and deploy electrical infrastructure across Amazon’s operational sites in Europe.  

  

About the team  

The Sustainability Engineering team drives the execution and deployment of EV charging infrastructure, grid connections, and smart grid solutions across Amazon’s European sites. We manage supply chain, procurement, and maintenance activities, and define the processes that ensure consistent, scalable delivery. To enable this, the team develops and continuously improves electrical standards and technologies that underpin reliable, compliant deployment at pace. We power Amazon’s sustainable growth through operational excellence and continuous innovation.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a foreign equivalent

* Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, electronic system design, and decision making
* Experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high\-speed manufacturing
* Experience with design\-in\-safety

Specjalizujemy się w budowie, rozwoju i utrzymaniu systemów i aplikacji, oraz doradztwie IT. Wierzymy, że najlepsze rozwiązania powstają wtedy, gdy jest przestrzeń na eksperymentowanie \- dlatego mamy własne R\&D Center na czele z NexioBot naszym mobilnym robotem asystującym, wykorzystującym sztuczną inteligencję do komunikacji.

**Opis stanowiska**
-------------------


Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy **Architekta IT / Software Architecta**, który będzie odpowiedzialny za projektowanie i rozwój architektury systemów oraz wsparcie zespołów deweloperskich w procesie transformacji technologicznej.


Szukamy osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na stykutechnologii i biznesu, potrafi podejmować samodzielne decyzje architektoniczne, ale jednocześnie potrafi przełożyć je na konkretne rozwiązania i jasno wyjaśnić ich uzasadnienie.

* Projektowanie architektury nowych oraz istniejących systemów, zarówno monolitycznych, jak i opartych o mikroserwisy.

* Współpraca z zespołami IT, biznesem oraz innymi interesariuszami.
**Nasze wymagania**
-------------------


* Bardzo dobra znajomość **.NET Framework** oraz **.NET Core / .NET 6\+**.
* Doświadczenie w pracy z **PHP 5\.x\-8\.x** oraz starszymi frameworkami, np. Zend, Symfony 2/3\.

* Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i budowie **API \- REST, SOAP**; znajomość GraphQL będzie dodatkowym atutem.

### **Description \& Requirements**


**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Corporate**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award\-winning success.


* Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy
* Augment your comprehensive skillset with expert training across decision\-making, change management, leadership, and business development
* Obtain 360\-degree support throughout your career life cycle, from early\-stage to seasoned leader
  

  

**What You’ll Be Part Of**


We are seeking an experienced Windows IT Engineer to lead the design, evolution, and integration of our Windows\-based infrastructure. You will drive architectural decisions regarding identity management (Active Directory/Entra ID), server operating systems, virtualization, automation, and security compliance. This role bridges high\-level business strategy with hands\-on technical implementation, ensuring that our Microsoft environment is scalable, resilient, and secure.

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**


**Architecture \& Design**


* Design end\-to\-end Windows server and client infrastructure (on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud).
* Develop and maintain the roadmap for Active Directory (AD DS), Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Certificate Services (PKI).
* Architect hybrid identity solutions integrating on\-prem AD with Azure AD (Entra ID) and Microsoft 365\.
* Design virtualization strategies (Hyper\-V, VMware) and storage configurations for Windows workloads.
* Plan high\-availability, disaster recovery, and backup solutions for Windows systems.
  

**Implementation \& Standards**


* Establish standards for Windows Server (2019/2022/2025\) and Windows 10/11 deployment (imaging, Autopilot, MDM).
* Design automated provisioning workflows using PowerShell, DSC (Desired State Configuration), or Ansible.
* Lead migration projects (e.g., legacy to modern platforms, on\-prem to Azure IaaS/PaaS).
* Define monitoring, patching, and update strategies (Windows Update for Business, WSUS, Azure Update Manager).
* Perform proof of concepts (POC) and proof of architecture (POA) with various hardware and software vendors to pick\-up the best solution.

**Security \& Compliance**


* Embed security best practices (Zero Trust, least privilege, LAPS, Credential Guard).
* Design RBAC models, tiered administration, and privileged access workstations (PAWs).

jobs.title: Senior Back-end/Python Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend / Python Developer to design, build, and evolve scalable backend services and data\-intensive systems supporting our Supply Chain planning solutions.


This is a hands\-on senior engineering role with a strong focus on Python backend development, APIs, databases, system design, and data processing. You will take technical ownership of backend components and contribute to architectural decisions, platform modernization, and the development of reliable and maintainable production systems.


You will work with modern data and AI\-enabled solutions, including data pipelines and services supporting AI/ML workloads. While experience with AI technologies is valuable, the core of this position is strong software engineering and backend development in Python.


The role is suited to an experienced developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, building production\-grade software, and contributing to both hands\-on implementation and long\-term technical direction.

**Backend \& Python Development**
---------------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain production\-grade backend services and APIs primarily using Python
* Take technical ownership of backend components throughout their lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement
* Design scalable, maintainable, and well\-structured application architectures
* Develop data\-intensive services for ingestion, processing, transformation, and serving of data
* Work extensively with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server
* Design efficient data\-access patterns
* Apply strong object\-oriented design, software engineering principles, and clean coding practices
* Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability bottlenecks
* Ensure high software quality through automated testing, code reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices
* Work with CI/CD and modern development and deployment practices
* Contribute to .NET\-based environments and integrations where relevant
* While the primary focus is backend development, opportunities to contribute to our Vue 3 frontend also exist

**Data Engineering \& AI\-Enabled Systems**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop backend services and data pipelines supporting AI/ML training, evaluation, and inference workloads
* Support the integration and productionization of AI/ML models, engines and services
* Work with technologies and patterns such as RAG, vector databases, and MCP
* Collaborate with application owners to translate application and data requirements into reliable technical solutions
* Contribute to the design of AI\-ready data architectures while maintaining strong software engineering standards

**Architecture \& System Design**
---------------------------------

* Play an active role in backend architecture and technical design decisions
* Design systems for scalability, maintainability, reliability, security, and operational efficiency
* Define and promote engineering patterns, standards, and best practices for Python and backend development
* Evaluate frameworks, libraries, platforms, and technologies based on technical and business requirements
* Make pragmatic architectural decisions that balance delivery needs with long\-term maintainability
* Document architectural decisions, interfaces, and important technical designs

**System Evolution \& Modernization**
-------------------------------------

* Modernize existing and legacy backend implementations
* Refactor complex or brittle components into maintainable, well\-tested solutions
* Improve the reliability, observability, performance, and scalability of existing systems
* Support migrations toward modern service and data architectures
* Identify and address technical debt in a structured and pragmatic way
* Help teams balance short\-term delivery requirements with long\-term technical sustainability

**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**
-----------------------------------------

* Mentor and technically support mid\-level and junior developers
* Perform and contribute to code and architecture reviews
* Support technical planning, estimation, and solution design
* Work closely with product, consultancy, data, AI, and infrastructure teams
* Provide technical expertise in client\-facing consultancy and pre\-sales activities
* Communicate technical concepts, architectural decisions, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least 5 years of professional software development experience with Python, with a substantial focus on backend development
* Master of Science (M.Sc.) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering, or another relevant technical field
* Strong knowledge of Python and modern Python software development practices
* Demonstrated experience designing and developing production\-grade backend services and APIs
* Strong understanding of software architecture, object\-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean\-code principles
* Strong experience with SQL and relational databases, preferably including PostgreSQL Microsoft and/or SQL Server
* Experience designing and implementing data\-intensive applications, data processing solutions, or data pipelines
* Experience with automated testing, version control, code reviews, and CI/CD practices
* Experience troubleshooting and optimizing production systems for performance, reliability, and scalability
* Experience working with modern deployment environments, preferably including containers and cloud\-based infrastructure
* Ability to independently drive technical tasks from requirements and design through implementation and production
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams
* Professional working proficiency in English

**Meriting Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Experience with Flask, Pandas or other comparable Python backend frameworks
* Experience with asynchronous Python and distributed or event\-driven systems
* Experience with workflow orchestration and data engineering platforms
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms
* Experience with Azure and the Microsoft technology ecosystem
* Experience with .NET/C\#
* Experience with AI/ML production systems and model integration
* Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM\-based applications, and MCP
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and production operations
* Experience with Vue 3 or other modern frontend technologies
* Experience in Supply Chain, planning, optimization, or related data\-intensive business domains
* Previous experience mentoring developers or acting as a technical lead

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================


You are an experienced Python developer with a strong software engineering foundation and a track record of building reliable backend systems. You are comfortable working across application logic, APIs, databases, data processing, and system architecture, and you understand what it takes to operate software successfully in production.


You enjoy hands\-on development but can also step back and consider the broader architecture. You can make pragmatic technical decisions, explain trade\-offs, improve existing systems, and help other developers grow.


Experience with data engineering and AI\-enabled applications is highly valuable, but deep Python and backend engineering expertise is the foundation of this role.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer**

**Reports to: Engineering Manager**

**Department: Engineering**

**Location: Gothenburg, Remote in Sweden**


Avinode is looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering team on a permanent basis. Over the past year we’ve been on a modernisation streak, reducing our maintenance load to be able to grow the team’s responsibilities and the kind of projects we can sustainably undertake. We’ve recently fully rebuilt our PCI enviornment, and are now undertaking a project to finalise our transition to exclusively running containerised services.


The team you’ll join consists of 4 DevOps/Site Reliability/Platform Engineers, supported by an Engineering Manager with a background in Site Reliability Engineering. We operate a cloud\-only environment and are responsible for its operation, availability, observability and security. Most of our systems are Linux\-based and run Java applications. But for this position we’re looking for someone with experience supporting a .NET/C\# and Windows application stack, or being an experienced .NET/C\# developer with an affinity for platform engineering and cloud infrastructure.

**What you’ll do**

* You’ll support the team as we work through adopting, modernising and rebuilding this part of our cloud environment. This will involve:
* Ensuring the Windows environment remains in good shape, through practices like automated security patching, configuration management and good integration with our observability stack.
* Improving and simplifing our Continuous Integration systems and pipelines.
* Contributing to the applications to improve how they leverage current Azure services, or adopt new Azure services, to reduce the maintenance cost.
* Harmonising how we operate and maintain our Windows and Linux environments, adopting the same toolset and practices across both where feasible.
* Supporting the work to run these applications on a Linux\-backed containerised stack.
* Contributing to the team’s roadmap, which will involve work related to security, observability and improving the developer experience.

**Who you are**

* You are a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer with 3\+ years of experience supporting a .NET/C\# and Windows stack for SaaS services. Or,
* You are a .NET/C\# developer with 3\+ years of experience, with an affinity for cloud infrastructure and at least a year of experience running and operating Windows systems to host SaaS services.
* You have worked with infrastructure in cloud environments before. We use Azure, but experience with AWS or GCP is welcome too.
* You’re familiar with tools like terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Azure Machine Configuration (or equivalent) etc.
* You have some familiarity with Linux systems and running containers.
* You have an interest in the security of our systems and infrastructure.
* You have a product mindset, seeing the infrastructure and our tooling as services we offer to other teams.
* You are self\-driven and can figure things out on your own with some support from others.

**What do we offer you?**


We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.

* Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations.
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important.
* Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings. We want to support your development and dreams.

**Want to join our crew?**


Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.title: Systemarkitekt inom C#/.NET
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och digitalisera skogsindustrin och arbeta med teknik som gör verklig skillnad för miljö och hållbarhet? Nu söker vi en Systemarkitekt till ett växande bolag här i Göteborg som utvecklar avancerade system för att effektivisera skogsbruket. Ansök idag\- vi tillämpar löpande urval!
  
  

**OM TJÄNSTEN:**  

I den här rollen får du en central position i ett sammansvetsat utvecklingsteam där du är med och bygger lösningar från grunden och vidareutvecklar befintliga system.
  
Du kommer att arbeta nära slutkunden, vilket ger dig en djup förståelse för verksamhetens behov och hur systemen används i praktiken. Det innebär också korta beslutsvägar och en nära dialog med användare, vilket gör att du snabbt ser effekten av det du utvecklar.
  
Bolaget fokuserar på att digitalisera och effektivisera skogsindustrin genom datadrivna lösningar. En viktig del av arbetet är system kopplade till GIS (geografiska informationssystem), där data används för att exempelvis analysera miljöförändringar, vattennivåer och andra faktorer som påverkar skogsbruket. Du kommer därför att arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan mjukvaruutveckling, dataanalys och verkliga tillämpningar. Tekniskt innebär rollen främst backendutveckling i C\#/.NET, ofta i molnbaserade miljöer inom Microsoft Azure.
  
  

**ARBETSUPPGIFTER:** Utveckla och förbättra molnbaserade applikationer inom Microsoft Azure
  
Arbeta med backendutveckling i C\#/.NET
  
Bidra till lösningar inom GIS och datadrivna analyser
  
Samarbeta nära både interna utvecklare och kund
  
Vara med och effektivisera processer inom skogsindustrin
  
**VI SÖKER DIG SOM:** Har en kandidat\- eller masterexamen inom mjukvaruutveckling, datateknik eller ett annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant
  
Har några års arbetslivserfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling
  
Har arbetslivserfarenhet inom C\#/.NET
  
  

**Det inte nödvändigt, men meriterande om du har:**  

Erfarenhet av eller intresse för GIS\-system
  
Arbetslivserfarenhet från skogsindustrin
  
Har erfarenhet av Python och/eller C/C\+\+
  
  

Vidare lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som är nyfiken och framåt, som inte tvekar att ställa frågor när något är oklart och som trivs i att samarbeta med andra. Du är en lagspelare som aktivt bidrar till en positiv och inkluderande teamkultur. Utöver det sitter vår kund i mycket trivsamma, ljusa lokaler där du har tillgång till gemensamt gym.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer till en början att vara anställd av Friday. Ambitionen från kund och vår sida är att du därefter bli tillsvidareanställd hos kundföretaget.

**Start:** Enligt överenskommelse
  
**Placering:** Göteborg
  
**Lön:** Marknadsmässig månadslön
  
  

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.
  
  

**OM FRIDAY:**  

På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech\-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.
  
Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.
  
Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high\-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory\- and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

 **About the role**


The open position is with our DDC PRS product team. We provide personnel\- and workforce management solutions to health regions and municipalities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will have a close dialogue with our customers. Furthermore, you will work closely with our architects, developers and application specialists. It is important that you contribute to improving processes and further contribute to us creating solutions that meet the customers' needs and create value for them. We are looking for you who are outgoing, quality\-conscious and work in a structured and systematic manner.  

Good communication skills both in writing and orally are a requirement.

 **In this role you will mainly:**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds readiness and resilience software for defence, public safety and critical infrastructure organisations in more than 70 countries. Our Exonaut platform is used to plan, run and evaluate large\-scale training, exercises and capability evaluations, and our consultants and engineers work alongside those organisations across Europe, North America and beyond.

**What we're building**


We're building the evidence layer for defence experimentation and evaluation. When an organisation tests a new capability — a sensor, an autonomous system, a different way of operating — it has to be able to defend the result afterwards, to someone who was not there and who has every reason to challenge it. Today that evidence lives in spreadsheets, documents and standalone survey tools, and it cannot be traced from a conclusion back to the observation that supports it.


Our platform fixes the structure before the data is collected, captures evidence from people and from machines, fuses it into chains that carry their own provenance, and keeps every finding traceable to its source. The hard part is not the plumbing. It is holding one coherent model steady while every customer arrives with their own vocabulary, their own method and a reasonable\-sounding request for one more special case.

**How we build**


Modern Java — currently 25 — and Spring Boot on a modular JPMS architecture, an Angular 21 single\-page application, PostgreSQL with PostGIS, deployed to Kubernetes.


The principles are conservative on purpose. Dependency inversion at every module boundary: contracts in an API module, implementation separate, no reverse dependencies. Schema evolution is explicit and reversible, through migrations with rollback scripts and no auto\-DDL in any environment. Evolutionary change over rewrites, with a staged path when a domain concern outgrows its boundary. Structural decisions are argued in RFCs and recorded in ADRs, and changes to the core domain model go through that process rather than around it — because that model is the product, and it is the thing most easily damaged under delivery pressure.


Three constraints shape most of what we do. It runs inside the customer's own environment: single\-tenant, sovereign, accredited, sometimes with no route to the internet at all, so nothing may assume a managed cloud service. Evidence has to be captured where the work happens, which means a tablet in a field with no connectivity and a sync that loses nothing. And the audit trail is immutable — evidence cannot be quietly deleted or backdated, and no automated process publishes a conclusion without a person taking responsibility for it.

**You**


We are a small team, so you will work across the stack rather than behind a specialism. Substantial experience in either Java or TypeScript, and a genuine willingness to be useful in the other. Sound judgement about data modelling, because most of the interesting problems here are modelling problems wearing engineering clothes. Comfortable with ambiguity: requirements move, and the shape of the answer is often the work.


A real advantage, though none of it is required: sovereign, air\-gapped or accredited deployments; offline\-first or sync\-heavy applications; geospatial data; sensor, telemetry or simulation integration; audit and traceability requirements. The domain is learnable, the judgement less so.


The team is small enough that your work is visible and your arguments carry. Your designs will be challenged and you will be expected to challenge back — including on scope.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Capability decisions get made on this evidence. When an organisation concludes that something is ready, or that it is not, that judgement has consequences for the people who depend on it. Making it defensible is the whole point.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript,


Python or Go).

* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why join 4C Strategies**


This is a small team with a large surface. You will not be handed a narrow lane: the platform is still being shaped, the domain model is still being argued about, and the person who makes the argument well is the person who decides. If you would rather own a hard, open problem end to end than take tickets from a backlog, that is the job.


The work matters: what you build helps defence, public safety and resilience organisations prepare for the situations they hope not to face.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Integration Platform Engineer (.NET/API)
jobs.description:
**Om rollen**


Hemsö är ett av Sveriges största fastighetsbolag med ett växande bestånd i Sverige, Finland och Tyskland. Vi befinner oss mitt i en ambitiös digitaliseringsresa — Digitala Klivet 2030 — där smart förvaltning, datadrivna beslut och sömlösa systemkopplingar är avgörande för att nå våra mål


Som Integration Platform Lead äger du den tekniska infrastruktur som binder samman Hemsös system. Du ansvarar för API\-plattformen och de integrationer som möjliggör allt från felanmälan till dataflöden mot vår analysplattform. Det är en roll med tydligt systemägarskap, bred teknisk räckvidd och direktpåverkan på hur Hemsö fungerar i vardagen.


Vad du kommer att göra:

**API\-plattform och integrationer**


Du är systemansvarig för Hemsös integrations\- och API\-plattform och de integrationer som kopplar samman verksamhetens system — fastighetssystem, felanmälan, HR, ekonomi och dataflöden mot analysplattformen ThoughtSpot. Du designar, bygger och förvaltar dessa kopplingar i .NET och Azure, inklusive automatiserade jobb som synkar data och triggar flöden mellan system. Du ansvarar även för den underliggande infrastrukturen, som definieras med Terraform och hanteras genom Azure DevOps\-pipelines. Du håller ett löpande fokus på stabilitet, teknisk skuld och beroenden.

**Felanmälan och Topdesk\-ekosystemet**


Du har förvaltnings\- och utvecklingsansvar för felanmälansflödet samt Hemsös hyresgästportal och de integrationer som omger Topdesk. Det innebär att du säkerställer att kopplingarna mot kringliggande system fungerar korrekt, att processlogiken hålls intakt vid förändringar, och att du kommunicerar proaktivt med berörda parter när något behöver justeras. Du samarbetar nära med den projektledare som äger felanmälansprocessen.

**Driftstabilitet och systemförvaltning**


Du hanterar uppdateringar, säkerhetspatchar och livscykelförändringar i en miljö med många externa beroenden. När en partner ändrar sitt API, en driftmiljö förändras eller ett certifikat löper ut ser du till att det landar utan störningar. Du arbetar proaktivt, dokumenterar tydligt och håller intressenter informerade i god tid. Vid incidenter eller driftstörningar samordnar du felsökning, driver dialogen med berörda parter och säkerställer att åtgärder vidtas för att minska risken för återkommande problem.

**AI som arbetsverktyg och agent\-enabler**


Du använder AI\-stödda verktyg naturligt i ditt dagliga arbete — för att skriva kod snabbare, felsöka smartare och bygga bättre lösningar. Du bidrar också till att Hemsös agentplattform (som ligger på Databricks) får de integrationer och API:er den behöver för att fungera i praktiken. Det är inte din roll att äga agentutvecklingen, men du är en möjlig\-görare för det arbetet. Du kan även vara behjälplig att ta ett egenutvecklat system från Claude Code/Lovable till produktion.

**Vem vi söker**


Du har gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i .NET och känner dig hemma i Azure — App Services, Functions, integrationsflöden och API\-design. Du har arbetat i miljöer med många systemberoenden och vet vad det innebär att äga en plattform på riktigt: inte bara koda, utan förvalta, prioritera och hålla ihop helheten över tid. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med Infrastructure as Code och automatiserade driftsättningar.


Du är självgående och trivs i en roll där ansvar och frihet hänger ihop. Du kommunicerar lika naturligt med en kollega i förvaltningen som undrar varför felanmälan inte fungerar som med en backend\-arkitekt som vill diskutera integrationsmönster. Du är nyfiken på AI\-verktyg och ser dem som ett sätt att leverera bättre — inte som ett buzzword.


Erfarenhet av HTMX eller liknande server\-side rendering\-mönster är ett plus — rollen arbetar med gränssnitt som Mina sidor och felanmälan, där designkomponenter redan är på plats och en backend\-profil förväntas kunna bidra till frontendutvecklingen. Det samma gäller bakgrund från verksamhetsnära systemarbete där tekniken behöver möta processer och människor, inte bara andra system.

**Vi erbjuder**


Hos Hemsö får du möjlighet att påverka investeringar och projekt som gör verklig skillnad för människor och samhällen. Du blir en del av en organisation med långsiktigt perspektiv, hög kompetens och korta beslutsvägar. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Flight Operations - Backend
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer \- Flight Operations Backend**
=========================================================


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a leading role in the development of the Avinode Flight Operations product offering. As a member of a product team made up of a Product Manager, UX Designer, Test Lead, and Software Engineers, you will plan, implement, and release business\-critical features for customers across the business aviation industry.

**What you will do**

* Working together with your teammates, design appropriate technical solutions to implement new product features and improve current features. You will be working both in our existing C\# .NET monolith (with React frontend) as well as developing new services when needed.
* Maintain and improve the team’s CI/CD tooling, including cloud deployments to Azure.
* Work to bring our codebase up to date with current best practices, libraries, and platforms.
* Research and advocate for new technologies and techniques that would be beneficial to your team and/or the wider Engineering organisation.
* Act as a mentor to less experienced engineers as a technical resource to Avinode Group as a whole, providing information, advice, and technical assistance when requested.

**Who you are**

* You have 7\+ years of experience building systems with .Net Framework and .Net Core and some experience working with React frontends. You are more experienced with backend development, but you will be expected to contribute to all parts of the stack when necessary.
* You have 2\+ years experience with relational databases and related tooling such as ORMs. We use MS SQL Server, but experience with another major RDBMS such as Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, etc is fine.
* You have experience managing and securing resources in a major public cloud such as Azure (which we use), AWS, or GCP.
* You have a proven track record of leading projects, mentoring other members of your team, and researching and integrating new tools and technologies into your work.
* You are familiar with software development and delivery best practices, and know how to ensure your team is following them.
* You communicate well. With offices in multiple time zones and multiple countries, this position requires strong written and verbal communication skills.

**What do we offer you?**


We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.

* Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations.
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important.
* Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings. We want to support your development and dreams.

**Want to join our crew?**


Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - IAM
jobs.description:
**What you tell your friends you do**


“I develop the identity and access management that keeps Aize secure and seamless, shaping the product experience as much as the code.”

**What you will really be doing**

Build and evolve responsive React and TypeScript experiences that make complex IAM workflows clear and intuitive.


Make pragmatic design decisions with product managers and our design system team, keeping the application cohesive while balancing functionality and deadlines.


Design and maintain integrations between our portal, backend services, and assorted third\-party systems.


Work across a broad surface area: backend, React frontend, and the DevOps infrastructure that keeps everything running.


Shape features with the product team scoping, estimating, and challenging the “why” behind what we build.


Mentor teammates, contribute to architectural discussions, and help facilitate agile ceremonies.


Support a team that owns everything end\-to\-end, from infra to UI, in a domain where you can grow.

**How you will be doing this**

* Working as part of a self\-driven team of seven that owns an entire “app within the app” \- full flow, full responsibility.
* Using and improving our DevOps setup (Terraform, CI/CD, cloud platforms), building on the foundations already established.
* Mostly focusing on frontend, but with the opportunity to jump into frontend and infrastructure when it makes sense.
* Collaborating closely with other engineering teams and other disciplines to balance technical depth with user and business needs.
* Bring your experience, curiosity, and the right attitude to help the team scale.

**Why you are doing this**


You are building a secure, scalable backbone that enables the product to function reliably as it grows. It protects customer trust and ensures users can access the product seamlessly.

**Who we think you are**

* An engineer who takes ownership, makes sound design and technical decisions, and navigates a broad product landscape.
* Strong in React and TypeScript, with experience building maintainable, accessible, and user\-friendly applications.
* Comfortable contributing to CI/CD and modern development practices; experience owning pipelines or third\-party systems is a plus.
* Curious about IAM or identity\-related domains, even if you haven’t worked in them before; C\#/.NET backend knowledge is a plus.
* Experience with identity solutions or platforms such as Auth0, Frontegg, Keycloak, Identiy Server is a plus.
* Comfortable collaborating with product managers, designers, and engineers, coordinating work, and contributing to architectural discussions.
* Someone who thinks holistically: cohesive product design, purpose, users, functionality, and deadlines \- not just code.

**Team**


We build and maintain the secure, scalable foundations that power the product, including user access and core platform services. Our work is AI\-enabled and follows modern software development lifecycle practices.


We collaborate closely across engineering, product, and security, supported by structured ceremonies, clear roadmap, and shared ownership. We practice continuous delivery using feature toggles to release changes safely and incrementally.

*Grounded*, *human*, and *unstoppable* are the values that guide our day\-to\-day. If that aligns with how you like to work, we’d love to hear from you

**We offer:**

* Money
* Hybrid work and flexible hours
* A MacBook or laptop running Windows, so you can get work done
* Support to help you keep your money: we chip in on your pension, pay for your work travels and keep you safe with insurance
* Care for your wellbeing, including an on\-site private health clinic and covered check\-ups
* Room for you to do things your way and be who you are
* Opportunities to learn and share through our professional Guilds, helping you grow your skills and inspire those around you
* Vacation perks \- maybe a few days at one of our cabins (Gaustablikk, Beitostølen, Hafjell, Tjøme, Spain \+\+). Just remember to come back
* Support for your passions through events, training and courses, you choose what interests you
* And of course the good stuff \- free phone plan, home broadband, solid hardware, on\-site gym, great lunch, afterwork socials and occasional celebration along the way
