jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Fast stilling Heltid Oslo
* Søknadsfrist **Snarest**
* Arbeidsspråk **Norsk**
* Sektor **Privat**

  
**Senior dataingeniør, eiendoms\- og geodata**
==============================================


Vi søker en erfaren dataingeniør som vil bygge og drifte dataplattformen bak Placepoint. Du henter inn, modellerer og leverer eiendoms\-, selskaps\- og kartdata fra Norge og Sverige, sammen med oss to som gjør det i dag, og du bruker AI som et fast verktøy i jobben.


Om oss
Placepoint samler eiendomsinformasjon, eierskap, regulering, transaksjoner og kartdata i én plattform for Norge og Sverige. Over 850 kunder bruker oss, blant dem eiendomsbesittere, utviklere, banker, forsikringsselskaper, meglere og advokater. Vi er over 70 ansatte og holder til i Oslo sentrum.
  

Dataene er kjernen i det vi leverer. Vi henter dem fra offentlige registre som Matrikkelen, Grunnboken og Enhetsregisteret, fra svenske kilder som Lantmäteriet og Bolagsverket, og fra over 2 300 kartlag. Kundene bruker dem i Placepoint Fusion, Placepoint API og gjennom våre MCP\-servere som lar AI\-assistenter slå opp i dataene direkte.  

  



Slik jobber vi
AI er en del av hvordan vi utvikler. Hvert repo har instruksjoner for Claude Code og Cursor, mye av koden skrives sammen med en AI\-agent, og vi bygger egne MCP\-servere så kunder og kolleger kan bruke dataene våre fra Claude og andre assistenter. Vi forventer at du bruker AI mye, og at du er med på å finne ut hvordan vi kan bruke det bedre.
  

Vi er et lite datateam med bredt ansvar. Den som bygger et dataløp, drifter det også, og vi rydder opp i årsaken når noe feiler.  

  



Dette skal du jobbe med
* Utvikle og optimalisere databasene våre i SQL Server og PostGIS: lagrede prosedyrer, datamodeller, indekser, partisjonering og ytelse på store tabeller.
* Bygge og drifte dataløp som henter registerdata hver natt og hver uke, med Azure Data Factory, Python\-jobber i Azure og dbt.
* Følge med på at kjøringene går, finne feilen når de ikke gjør det, og gjøre dem robuste nok til at det skjer sjeldnere.
* Modellere og koble norske og svenske registre: eiendom, bygg, adresser, selskaper, roller, eierskap og transaksjoner.
* Videreutvikle Placepoint API, MCP\-serverne våre og søkeindeksene i Azure AI Search.
* Ta inn nye kartlag og datakilder, og holde dem oppdatert.
* Levere datasett til kunder og hjelpe kolleger i produkt og salg med data og analyser.

Vi ser etter deg som
* har minst seks års relevant arbeidserfaring
* har høyere utdanning innen informatikk, geomatikk, matematikk eller lignende, eller tilsvarende arbeidserfaring
* er svært god på SQL Server eller PostgreSQL: du skriver effektiv SQL, leser spørringsplaner, lager indekser som holder og modellerer data som skal leve lenge
* har bygget og driftet dataløp i produksjon, med Azure Data Factory, Airflow, dbt eller tilsvarende
* programmerer godt i Python eller C\#, gjerne begge
* bruker Claude, Cursor eller lignende AI\-verktøy mye i hverdagen, eller er motivert for å gjøre det
* snakker og skriver norsk flytende

Det er et pluss om du har erfaring med
* PostGIS og geodata: geometri, koordinatsystemer som EUREF89 UTM, GeoJSON, GeoParquet og vektorfliser
* norske registre og kartdata: Enhetsregisteret, Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Aksjonærregisteret og FKB fra Kartverket
* svenske registre og data: Lantmäteriet, Bolagsverket og SCB
* API\-design, MCP\-servere og søkemotorer som Azure AI Search eller Elasticsearch
* Azure: Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault og Data Lake
* Go
* 3D\-data og bygningsmodeller
* eiendomsbransjen eller finans

Ingen har alt dette. Vi jobber bredt, og du lærer nye verktøy mens du bruker dem. Det som veier tyngst, er at du lærer fort, bruker AI godt og bryr deg om at dataene er riktige.  

  



Om deg
* Du legger merke til når tall ikke stemmer, og graver til du finner årsaken.
* Du tar ansvar for det du lager, også etter at det er i drift.
* Du jobber selvstendig, deler det du finner og ber om hjelp når det sparer tid.
* Du kan forklare et datasett og begrensningene i det til en kollega som ikke er utvikler.
* Du trives med å jobbe på kontoret sammen med teamet.
**Ferdigheter**
---------------

* Data Engineering
* Data Modeling
* Kodegjennomgang
* kvalitetssikring av data
* Orkestrere musikk
* PostGIS
* Python (dataprogrammering)
* SQL

  
**Om arbeidsgiveren**
---------------------


Placepoint bygger dataplattformen for eiendom i Norge og Sverige.


Banker, eiendomsutviklere, investorer og rådgivere bruker plattformen til å finne, analysere og følge eiendommer, selskaper og planer, med data fra Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Brønnøysundregistrene, Lantmäteriet og en rekke andre kilder samlet på ett sted.


* Sted: Tordenskiolds Gate 2, 0177 Oslo
* Bransje: Eiendom, IT \- programvare
* Stillingsfunksjon: Dataingeniør
**Nøkkelord**
-------------


lakehouse, dbt, postgis, mcp, ETL



**Spørsmål om stillingen**
--------------------------


FF
Frede Fardal


CPO


JB
Jarle Bjørnbeth


Head of Data

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Fornebu, Norway


* Full\-time
* Application and Product Development
* Hybrid
* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide employees in health regions and municipalities with product offerings that help them in their daily work, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

 **About us**


Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high\-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory\- and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

 **About the role**


The open position is with our DDC PRS product team. We provide personnel\- and workforce management solutions to health regions and municipalities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will have a close dialogue with our customers. Furthermore, you will work closely with our architects, developers and application specialists. It is important that you contribute to improving processes and further contribute to us creating solutions that meet the customers' needs and create value for them. We are looking for you who are outgoing, quality\-conscious and work in a structured and systematic manner.  

Good communication skills both in writing and orally are a requirement.

 **In this role you will mainly:**

* Install and upgrade Tieto Workforce Planner with associated applications in internal test environments and with existing and new customers.
* Carry out packaging, technical verification and delivery of new versions of the software.
* Help move on\-prem infrastructure to cloud both internal as well as customer installations.
* Contribute to maintaining Workforce Planner in a cloud environment
* Improve and automate solutions for software packaging, delivery and deployment of the product.
* Maintain and improve technical documentation for installation of the solution.
* Maintain internal environments.
* Carry out migration of the solutions from old to new servers when customers upgrade infrastructure.
* Assist technical operations staff at the customer when necessary.

 **Secondary you will:**

* Develop SQL scripts to meet the customer's needs for customized data extraction.
* Maintain and improve infrastructure for automated testing.
* Testing web service APIs.
* Optimize database queries.

 **It is an absolute requirement that you master both Norwegian and English fluently in writing and orally.**

 **We are looking for someone with:**

* 3\-year education in ICT.
	+ Relevant experience can compensate for a lack of formal education.
* Experience with:
	+ Azure DevOps and pipelines.
	+ Windows Server and management of rights, certificates.
	+ IIS and configuration of web applications.
	+ SQL Server and SQL script.
	+ PowerShell / bat\-scripting.
* Good communication skills

 **It would be beneficial if you also:**

* Version management systems such as Git.
* Container frameworks such as Docker.
* Programming skills in C\#.
* Testing web services with Bruno/Postman or similar tools.
* Infrastructure management on Azure.

 **AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarizing, analyzing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing products beneficial for health regions and municipalities. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, an open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work\-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

 **Could you be our new colleague?**


We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Svein Johan Hauge, svein.johan.hauge@tieto.com

 *We perform background checks on all final candidates.*

*Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.*

  

Additional Information  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.  

Diversity, equity and inclusion \| Sustainability \| Tieto

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud \| Tieto Blog

  
We provide customers across different industries with mission\-critical solutions through our specialized software businesses Tieto Caretech, Tieto Banktech and Tieto Indtech as well as Tieto Tech Consulting business.


Our around 14 000 talented vertical software, design, cloud and AI experts are dedicated to empowering our customers to succeed and innovate with latest technology.


Tieto’s annual revenue is approximately EUR 2 billion. The company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Stillingsbeskrivelse**
------------------------


Er du en engasjert tech\-entusiast som elsker å jobbe med moderne datateknologier? Hos Sopra Steria blir du en del av et inspirerende og inkluderende miljø – et av Norges råeste tech\-miljøer – hvor vi kombinerer utfordrende prosjekter med en kultur preget av nysgjerrighet, læring og samarbeid. Vi tror at du, med din evne til å tilegne deg ny kunnskap og din genuine interesse for teknologi, vil trives og vokse hos oss. Hos oss vil du bidra i varierte oppdrag på tvers av bransjer og sektorer, og være med på å utvikle morgendagens dataløsninger sammen med noen av Norges fremste fageksperter  

  

  

Her får du muligheten til å forme morgendagens dataløsninger i et dynamisk team med høyt kvalifiserte kollegaer.

**Ansvarsområder**:


* **Utvikling og design**  

Du vil være med å designe og sette opp event\-drevne arkitekturer. Ved å integrere meldingstjenester som Kafka og Pub/Sub, oppnår vi sanntids databehandling, rask respons og en robust, hendelsesbasert arkitektur som gir oss økt fleksibilitet og effektivitet.
* **Dataprosessering**  

Du jobber med distribuerte plattformer for å prosessere store datamengder. Dette innebærer avansert datamodellering for å strukturere, transformere og gjøre data om til verdifull innsikt.
* **Skyteknologier**  

Vil du være med å designe, sette opp og optimalisere løsninger på Azure, AWS og GCP? Her utnytter du tjenester for lagring, serverless computing og containere for å bygge systemer som er sikre, skalerbare og kostnadseffektive.
* **Infrastruktur som kode**  

Du vil være med på å designe og implementere skyinfrastruktur ved hjelp av moderne IaC\-verktøy, som Terraform, Biceps og tilsvarende.

  

I prosjektene våre vil du kombinere denne tekniske kompetansen med evnen til å forstå kundens behov, samarbeide godt med ulike fagmiljøer og levere løsninger som er robuste, optimaliserte og som skaper tydelig verdi for kundene våre.

**Kvalifikasjoner**:

* Høyere utdanning innen IT, dataingeniørfag eller beslektede fagområder.
* Minimum to års relevant arbeidserfaring med dataplattformer.
* Erfaring med distribuerte systemer og skyteknologier.
* Gode programmeringsferdigheter, spesielt i Python. Erfaring med Go, Kotlin, C\# eller Java er en fordel.
* Gjerne erfaring med event\-arkitekturer og bruk av meldingstjenester.
* Gjerne erfaring med infrastruktur som kode.
* Norsk, minimum B2 nivå

**Personlige egenskaper:**

* Du er faglig sterk og har en genuin interesse for dataplattformer
* Du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og deler gjerne kunnskap
* Du trives i møte med ulike mennesker og samarbeider tett med både kunder og kollegaer
* Du kommuniserer klart og skaper tillit i dialog med andre
* Du jobber selvstendig, men liker også å løse problemer i team
* Du tar initiativ, er løsningsorientert og bidrar til et positivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

 **Hvorfor Sopra Steria?**

  

Hos oss får du jobbe med meningsfulle og varierte prosjekter for noen av Norges største virksomheter. Vi satser på kontinuerlig faglig og personlig utvikling gjennom sertifiseringsprogrammer, opplæring og støtte fra faglige miljøer. Du vil jobbe i et dynamisk miljø med gode kollegaer, konkurransedyktige betingelser og fleksible arbeidsforhold. Det finnes uttallige faglige og sosiale tilbud, og vi kan tilby en ferieuke ekstra. Vi er stolte av vår kultur og vårt engasjement for teknologi. Du trenger ikke oppfylle alle kravene for å være den perfekte kandidaten. Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i mye av det vi beskriver og ønsker å utvikle deg sammen med oss, ser vi frem til å høre fra deg!

 **Kontaktinfo:**  

Stig\-Ole Gundersen (Leder, Data Intelligence) via epost: stig\-ole.gundersen@soprasteria.com hvis du har spørsmål om rollen, kontakt Glenn Bøe (Rekrutteringsrådgiver) via glenn.boe@soprasteria.com hvis du har spørsmål om prosess.


Sopra Steria har kunder og prosjekter som kan kreve sikkerhetsklarering på ulike nivåer.  

Vi selekterer og inviterer kandidater til intervju fortløpende.

**Ytterligere informasjon**
---------------------------


Vi er Norges ledende konsulentselskap innen digitalisering, innovasjon og bærekraft. I Sopra Steria bistår vi våre kunder innen privat og offentlig sektor med å bli fremtidens virksomheter. I en årrekke har vi vært rangert som en av Norges beste arbeidsplasser. Du finner oss i Oslo, Stavanger, Trondheim, Bergen, Drammen, Hamar, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Tromsø.



Når du klikker på lenken over eller en tredjepartslenke i denne postingen, forlater du denne siden og går til en tredjepartsnettside der tredjepartens vilkår og personvernerklæring gjelder

jobs.title: Backend- og DevOps-udvikler til vores IT Digital Commerce-team
jobs.description:
**Erfaren backend\- og DevOps\-udvikler til vores IT Digital Commerce\-team**  

Vil du arbejde med både backendudvikling, integrationer og den teknik, der får løsningerne sikkert i drift? Vi søger en erfaren backend\- og DevOps\-udvikler til vores IT Digital Commerce\-team i Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group. Du kommer til at arbejde med de systemer, der ligger bag vores hjemmesider og online booking – fra udvikling og databaser til deployment, fejlsøgning og drift. Vi står foran en større modernisering af vores digitale platform og bookingløsning. Samtidig har vi eksisterende systemer, som skal fungere stabilt, mens vi bygger nyt. Derfor leder vi efter en udvikler, der både kan skrive god kode og interesserer sig for, hvad der sker med løsningen, efter den er deployet.

  

  

**Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med?**  

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:


* Udvikle og vedligeholde backend\-løsninger i C\# og .NET
* Bygge og vedligeholde integrationer til hotel\-, booking\- og betalingssystemer
* Arbejde med Microsoft SQL Server og vores databaser
* Automatisere arbejdsgange og driftsopgaver med PowerShell
* Vedligeholde og forbedre vores build\- og deployment\-processer
* Arbejde med overvågning, fejlsøgning og sikker drift
* Være med til at modernisere vores eksisterende løsninger
* Sparre med resten af teamet om arkitektur og tekniske valg


Rollen er en blanding af backendudvikling og DevOps. Du behøver ikke være ekspert i alt, men du skal have solid erfaring og lyst til at arbejde på tværs og tage ansvar for løsningerne hele vejen fra kode til produktion.

  

  

**Vores tekniske setup**  

Vi arbejder blandt andet med:


* C\# og .NET 4\.8 samt .NET 10
* Microsoft SQL Server
* PowerShell
* Windows Server og i mindre omfang Linux
* TeamCity til builds
* Octopus Deploy til deployment
* GitLab
* TypeScript og JavaScript – også i dele af backenden


Vi kommer til at arbejde mere med containerbaseret drift. Derfor er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Kubernetes og Docker eller Podman.

  

  

**Hvem er du?**  

Vi forventer, at du har minimum fem års erfaring fra en lignende stilling og en solid baggrund inden for C\# og .NET.


Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:


* Har erfaring med SQL og databaser
* Har arbejdet med eller har interesse for CI/CD, deployment og drift
* Kan sætte dig ind i eksisterende systemer og kode
* Arbejder struktureret med fejlsøgning og problemløsning
* Tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs
* Kan forklare tekniske problemstillinger og har lyst til at dele din viden og sparre med resten af teamet


Erfaring med serverdrift, containere eller integrationer mellem flere systemer er en fordel. Vi forventer dog ikke, at du kan sætte flueben ved samtlige teknologier på listen.

  

  

**Dit team**  

Du bliver en del af IT Digital Commerce, hvor vi arbejder med Arp\-Hansen Hotel Groups hjemmesider, bookingløsninger og andre digitale løsninger til vores gæster og hoteller. Teamet består af udviklere, UX’ere og en team lead. Vi arbejder tæt sammen og har en praktisk tilgang til opgaverne. Der er plads til at stille spørgsmål, udfordre eksisterende løsninger og komme med forslag til, hvordan vi kan gøre tingene bedre. Vi udvikler selv vores centrale løsninger. Det betyder, at du kommer tæt på både systemerne og de mennesker, der bruger dem, og at du får mulighed for at være med til at forme den tekniske retning.

  

  

**Din arbejdsplads**  

Vores kontor ligger i Gentofte, og vi arbejder fra kontoret fire dage om ugen. Der er mulighed for én ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag, men stillingen er ikke en remote\-stilling. Du får en hverdag med både nyudvikling, modernisering og ansvar for løsninger, der allerede er i drift. Nogle opgaver er store og langsigtede, mens andre handler om at finde og løse et konkret problem eller få et hotfix i produktion her og nu. Tonen er uformel, og stemningen er uhøjtidelig. Vi siger tingene, som de er, hjælper hinanden og forsøger at holde mængden af unødigt bureaukrati på et minimum.


Vi opfordrer alle – uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet eller baggrund – til at ansøge om arbejde hos os i Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group. Vi tror på, at et mangfoldigt og inkluderende arbejdsmiljø er fundamentet for at opbygge tillid, skabe nærvær og fremme ambitioner. Det er vores mål at placere os helt i front i branchen med fokus på kvalitet, service og trivsel for gæster og medarbejdere. Hos os bliver alle ansøgere vurderet på deres kvalifikationer og potentiale, og vi prioriterer at skabe et miljø, hvor alle føler sig velkomne og værdsatte.


Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig! Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.


  
Application due
18\-10\-2026  


Start date
Start hurtigst muligt  


Position category
IT\-afdeling  


Position type
Fuldtid  


Workplace  


Homepage
http://www.arp\-hansen.dk  


**Questions regarding the position**
====================================


**Jacob Nielsen**
  
Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group er en familieejet virksomhed med central beliggenhed i København og Aarhus. Vi har over 5000 værelser, 60\+ mødelokaler og en kongressal. Vores hoteller udgør cirka 20 % af Københavns værelseskapacitet og omfatter Phoenix Copenhagen, 71 Nyhavn Hotel, Copenhagen Strand, Imperial Hotel, The Square, Tivoli Hotel \& Congress Center, Copenhagen Island, Gentofte Hotel, 4 Wakeup Copenhagen hoteller samt to luksushostels, Steel House Copenhagen og Next House Copenhagen.



Vores målsætning er at være blandt de bedste i branchen, når det kommer til kvalitet, service og tilfredshed. På vores kontor i Gentofte er vi omkring 100 kolleger, der dækker forskellige støttefunktioner inden for Sales, Marketing \& Brand, HR, Central Group Sales \& Reservations, Sustainability, Supply Chain, Finance og IT. Vores opgave er at give vores kolleger på hotellerne den bedste support, så vi sammen kan fokusere på at give vores gæster de bedste oplevelser.



Siden vores begyndelse i 60'erne har vi været familieejet, og det er familien Arp\-Hansens værdier, der i dag udgør grundlaget for vores virksomhed. Vi behandler vores medarbejdere ordentligt, vi stræber altid efter udvikling og sammen er vi alle en del af familien. Alle vores hoteller og hostels er Green Key certificerede hvilket, sammen med øvrige bæredygtige initiativer, bekræfter vores høje fokus på bæredygtighed.


**Tillid**, **nærvær** og at være **ambitiøs** – vores tre værdier, som afspejler, hvordan vi arbejder i Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group. Vi tror på, at vi vokser, tager mere ansvar og får større arbejdsglæde, når vi bliver vist **tillid** – og får hjælp, når vi har brug for det. **Nærvær** indebærer at være til stede og udvise ægte interesse for både kolleger og gæster på vores hoteller og hostels. At være **ambitiøs** er en naturlig del af at drive forretning. Det er ganske enkelt mere givende, altid at forsøge at gøre tingene lidt bedre.



Hos Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group ser vi dig som den person, du er. Vi er sikre på, at du vil føle dig hjemme hos os, for når du føler dig hjemme, kan du få vores gæster til at føle det samme. "Lad din karriere komme hjem."

jobs.description:
Digify is a cloud\-based document security and data room platform used by over 800,000 professionals across 138 countries to protect sensitive documents and control how they are accessed, shared, and tracked.
  
  

We’re building the next generation of secure document infrastructure across browsers, cloud storage, email, web, and mobile platforms — helping organizations maintain control over sensitive information after it leaves their hands.
  
  

**Our engineering team works on systems involving:**  

secure document delivery and viewing
  
  

authentication and access control
  
  

encryption and file handling
  
  

browser and cloud integrations
  
  

scalable backend services and analytics
  
  

We’re looking for an engineer who has strong software engineering fundamentals, enjoys building real\-world production systems, and is adaptable to evolving development workflows, including AI\-assisted and agentic coding tools.
  
  

What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

Design, build, and maintain features across our document security platform
  
  

Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other engineers throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  

Work across backend and frontend systems, with opportunities to contribute to browser integrations and mobile\-related functionality
  
  

Develop systems related to authentication, access control, file delivery, and secure document handling
  
  

Contribute to APIs, integrations, background workers, and analytics pipelines
  
  

Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ship reliable, maintainable software
  
  

Debug and resolve production issues and technical problems.
  
  

**Requirements:**  

Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  
  

3–6 years of software engineering experience, including experience working on production systems
  
  

Strong fundamentals in software engineering, algorithms, and system design
  
  

Experience with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks
  
  

Experience with .Net Framework and C\#
  
  

Experience with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, etc.)
  
  

Comfortable contributing across both frontend and backend systems, while being stronger in one area
  
  

Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and technical judgment
  
  

Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code
  
  

Comfortable working in evolving product and technical environments with changing requirements and priorities
  
  

Openness to modern development workflows, including AI\-assisted and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.)
  
  

**Nice\-to\-have:**  

Experience with security, encryption, authentication, or access control systems
  
  

Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, or event\-driven architectures
  
  

Experience with browser extensions, mobile apps, or file\-heavy systems
  
  

Experience integrating with third\-party APIs and cloud platforms (Google, AWS, etc.)
  
  

Experience with automated testing and modern software development practices.
  
  

**Why Join Digify:**  

Work on technically challenging security and file\-platform problems
  
  

Be part of an experienced and collaborative engineering team
  
  

Build products used by organizations around the world
  
  

Take ownership of meaningful systems and product areas
  
  

Digify is a cloud\-based document security and data room software that allows customers to control, protect and track important documents after sharing them. Companies use Digify to protect confidential information for fundraising and due diligence, secure intellectual property, and protect sensitive communications.
  
  

Digify is used in 138 countries today. We have more than 600,000 users worldwide.
  
  

Learn more about Digify by visiting our website (https://digify.com).

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Software Development Engineer I to join the Product Data Management (PDM) engineering team in Singapore.

  

The PDM team develops and maintains Autodesk's Product Data Management solutions, supporting customers worldwide in managing engineering design data across distributed environments. Our products include desktop and web applications, cloud services, file and database replication technologies, SDKs, CAD integrations, and enterprise\-scale solutions.

  

As a P1 Software Development Engineer, you will work alongside experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and maintain software features while building your technical expertise in enterprise software development.

* Develop, test, debug, and maintain software features under the guidance of senior engineers

* Collaborate with Software Engineers, Quality Assurance Engineers, UX Designers, and Product Managers throughout the development lifecycle
* Assist in troubleshooting defects and resolving production or customer\-reported issues

Software Engineering Fundamentals

* Understand software design principles and coding best practices
* Build an understanding of software architecture and component interactions.
* Develop maintainable, reliable, and testable software

  

Systems Thinking

jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer (Europe, 100% remote)
jobs.description:
Join our fully remote, mission\-driven team dedicated to pioneering **sustainable inflight service management**. Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities.


Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion.


#### **About the role**


We are hiring a **Senior Data \& Analytics Engineer** to take **end\-to\-end ownership of our data platform and BI layer**.


We are on a mission to contribute to a **zero\-waste future** by drastically reducing food waste, fuel consumption, costs, and most importantly, **CO₂ emissions** in the airline industry. Every role in our company is a direct contributor to this vision \- and as a **Senior Data \& Analytics Engineer** you will be at the forefront of turning data into meaningful insights, empowering our customers to effectively use them and drive real impact.


You will evolve a vendor\-built BI solution into a **modern, product\-grade data platform** and ensure that data is transformed into **scalable, trusted, and actionable insights** for both our customers and internal teams. You’re not just building dashboards, you’re enabling better decisions and measurable impact.


This role combines:

* **Data Engineering** (pipelines, processing, customer facing exports, platform)
* **Analytics Engineering** (modeling, KPIs, semantic layer)
* **Data Product Ownership** (customer impact, insight generation)

#### **What You’ll Own**

**Platform, Architecture \& Pipelines**


Own the end\-to\-end data platform (**Databricks** and **Microsoft Fabric**)

* Design and operate scalable pipelines and lakehouse architecture
* Build scalable ETL/ELT workflows and manage batch/near real\-time processing
* Ensure data quality, reliability, observability, and performance
* Define standards, data contracts, and architecture principles (clean, modular, scalable data platform)
* Optimize cost (e.g. Databricks jobs) and workload distribution across platforms

**Data Modeling \& Semantic Layer**

* Own **Power BI** semantic models and KPIs
* Build clean, scalable dimensional models (star schema)
* Ensure performance and consistency of DAX, aggregations, and dataset refresh

**Customer\-Facing Analytics**

* Build and maintain customer\-facing dashboards and embedded analytics
* Ensure consistent and trusted metrics across all outputs
* Enable self\-service analytics with governance
* Maintain and monitor customer facing exports

**Data as Product**

* Translate business and customer needs into scalable data solutions
* Define KPIs and reporting standards with Product
* Proactively build insights and identify opportunities to create additional customer value
* Drive measurable customer and business impact

**Platform Quality, Operations, Security \& Governance**

* Build necessary validation scripts, unit tests, data quality checks
* Implement CI/CD, testing, and versioning for pipelines and BI
* Support multi\-tenant architecture, security, and governance
* Implement monitoring and alerting (pipelines, refreshes)

**Migration \& Insourcing (Initial Focus)**

* Take ownership of a vendor\-built BI solution
* Reverse\-engineer pipelines, logic, and reports
* Reduce technical debt and rebuild toward a clean architecture

#### **What We’re Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5\+ years in data engineering / analytics engineering for customer\-facing BI products
* Experience in SaaS or product\-driven environments
* Proven track record building scalable data platforms and customer\-facing analytics

**Technical \& Platform Skills**

* Strong experience with:
	+ Databricks (Spark / PySpark, Delta Lake)
	+ Microsoft Fabric or Azure data stack
	+ Power BI (data modeling, DAX, performance)
* Advanced SQL and dimensional modeling (Kimball) expertise
* Lakehouse architecture \& ETL/ELT design
* Multi\-tenant data models \& embedded analytics

**Engineering Practices**

* CI/CD for data pipelines and BI assets
* Write reusable, modular, maintainable and testable code.
* Monitoring and data quality practices
* Version control (e.g., Git)

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Azure infrastructure knowledge (IAM, networking)
* Data quality/testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations)

**Mindset**

* Strong ownership and autonomy: You take full ownership of outcomes, not just tasks
* Impact\-driven: You focus on real\-world results and have strong intuition for identifying patterns, anomalies, and optimization opportunities
* Product thinker: You connect data to user value and turn raw data into clear, actionable insights
* Proactive: You proactively identify opportunities, validate ideas, and build reports, dashboards, and analyses without waiting for requirements.
* Domain expert: You understand business contexts quickly and translate problems into effective data solutions.
* Pragmatic: You prioritize simplicity and avoid overengineering, focusing on what delivers value.
* Clear communicator: You communicate effectively across technical and business stakeholders, making complex topics easy to understand.

#### **Language**


Min. English C1

#### **Expected travel needs**


2 annual one\-week team events

#### **Our Tech Stack**

* C\# (.NET 8–10\), ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core
* Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Blob Storage
* Azure App Services \& Functions, Docker
* Azure Service Bus, Terraform
* GitHub Actions, SonarQube, extensive unit \& integration tests
* Angular Latest Version
* Databricks and Azure Fabric

#### **Hiring Process**

* Recruiter Screen (45 mins)
* Interview with the Hiring Manager (1 hour)
* Technical interview (1 hour)
* Discussion with founder(s) and peer(s) (1 hour)

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work.


Join us and be part of a team committed to shaping a zero\-waste future for aviation, where your ideas and passion truly matter.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and Asia. We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses.

  

If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey.

**The role**

  

As a Senior Data Engineer, you are a key player in designing, implementing, and maintaining data pipelines and architectures. You work closely with clients to understand their data needs and realise tailored solutions that drive business insights. Your technical expertise and strong methodology help you bring your projects and clients to success.

 **How you’ll make an impact**

  

* Whether in the cloud or an on\-premises data center, you expertly navigate the world of Big Data, helping our clients make their data business\- or operations\-ready.
* You access diverse data sources efficiently and reproducibly.
* You design, test, and monitor distributed data processing pipelines.
* You work closely with data scientists in the creation of machine learning models.
* You perform performance and cost estimations for various use cases.
* You develop and create meaningful dashboards to visualize processed data.

 **What’s important to us**

  

* You are comfortable with Big Data, massively scalable databases, cloud infrastructures, and distributed algorithms.
* You have a passion for sustainable software development and have gathered several years of experience in technical roles.
* Along with your expertise in Python and SQL, you ideally have hands\-on experience or a strong interest in technologies such as Hadoop, Apache Spark, Hive, Airflow, RDBMS, NoSQL, DevOps, Kubernetes, and Java or .NET
* You have a good understanding of the capabilities in large public cloud environments and may have used resources from Amazon AWS, MS Azure, or Google’s GCP.
* You hold a university degree (ETH, Uni, FH) in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a similar field.
* Fluency in both German and English is required for this position.

 **What we offer**

* **Work life blend:** we offer a safe \& healthy workplace, with flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home
* **Profit share scheme:** In addition to your annual salary, you may receive a profit share defined by the company’s success in the previous year.
* **Global and Diverse Zühlke community:** witness how colleagues from all our offices across the globe come together to create a unique, positive and inclusive work culture, learning from one another at annual team camps, and celebrating year\-end parties and other local festivities.
* **Committed to development:** we are committed to the growth of our people and are investing in your development. We’re empowering you to build the skills you need to make a positive impact, both personally and for our clients, today and in the future.

  

If you feel you don't meet all the requirements, we are still happy to get to know you, learn more about your ambitions and ideas and look forward to receiving your application!  



  

We welcome people from all backgrounds, regardless of their gender, personality, national origin, race, religion, colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability or veteran status.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Join CERN's Vacuum, Surfaces and Coatings Group and contribute to engineering projects supporting the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) experiments.


As a Mechanical Engineer in the Experimental Vacuum team, you will work on the design, development, production and testing of ultra\-high vacuum equipment around the ATLAS, ALICE, CMS and LHCb experiments.


You will take part in projects from initial engineering concepts through design, simulation and prototyping to testing, installation and operational follow\-up. Working alongside engineers, technicians and specialists from other disciplines, you will gain hands\-on experience with complex mechanical systems in a unique scientific environment.

**Your responsibilities**

* Design and develop precision mechanical equipment for ultra\-high vacuum applications.
* Create 3D CAD models and perform structural, thermal and modal analyses to validate designs.
* Follow projects through design, prototyping, manufacturing, assembly and testing.
* Plan and carry out laboratory tests, including leak detection, residual gas analysis and vacuum performance measurements.
* Work with CERN workshops, suppliers and technical teams to support production and quality control.
* Contribute to the installation, commissioning and improvement of vacuum equipment for the LHC experiments.
* Collaborate across engineering disciplines to solve technical challenges and deliver reliable solutions.

**Your profile**

* Mechanical design and CAD (CATIA, Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks or similar).
* Engineering simulation and analysis (ANSYS or similar).
* Precision mechanics, manufacturing, assembly or testing.
* Vacuum technology or laboratory environments.
* Experience with ultra\-high vacuum systems, leak detection or residual gas analysis is an advantage, but you do not need experience in all these areas.


Skills

* Good foundation in mechanical engineering and design.
* Interest in developing expertise in ultra\-high vacuum and precision engineering.
* Practical, curious and solution\-oriented approach.
* Clear communication and commitment to high\-quality engineering.
* Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.

jobs.title: Controls and Automation Engineer (EN-CV-CL-2026-230-GRAE)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

The Cooling \& Ventilation (CV) Group is responsible for the design, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of the cooling systems, pumping stations, air conditioning plants, and fluid distribution networks serving CERN's accelerator complex, experimental areas, selected LHC detector cooling systems, and strategic technical infrastructures such as the Computer Centre.


This project aims to identify, evaluate, and implement solutions to improve the energy efficiency and performance of existing and future CV plants. The Project Engineer will analyse plant operation, develop physical models of HVAC and hydraulic systems using simulation tools, and assess alternative control strategies. Based on these studies, the engineer will design and validate process and control improvements, and manage their deployment, testing, and commissioning on operational plants to ensure the expected performance and energy savings are achieved.

**Your responsibilities**

* Develop and validate dynamic simulation models of HVAC, cooling, ventilation, and hydraulic systems to assess plant performance and evaluate energy optimisation opportunities.
* Design, test, and implement control system improvements, including advanced control strategies, to enhance energy efficiency, reliability, and operational stability.
* Apply data analytics, Machine Learning, and neural network techniques to support performance monitoring, fault detection, predictive analysis, and process optimisation.
* Manage the deployment, testing, commissioning, and performance verification of selected process, control, and AI\-based solutions on operational production plants.
* Produce technical studies, engineering recommendations, and performance assessments, and collaborate with operations and maintenance teams to ensure successful implementation of improvements.


More information here.

**Your profile**

* Experience in modelling and simulation of physical systems (HVAC, hydraulic, thermal, or industrial processes) using tools such as EcosimPro, Matlab/Simulink, or similar platforms.
* Experience in the design, implementation, testing, and commissioning of industrial control systems, with knowledge of advanced control techniques considered an asset.
* Experience in data analysis and software development using Python; familiarity with data analytics, machine learning, or artificial intelligence libraries is an advantage.


Skills

* System Modelling \& Simulation: HVAC, hydraulic, and industrial process modelling using EcosimPro, Matlab/Simulink, or equivalent tools.
* PLC Programming \& Automation: Siemens Step7, TIA Portal, and/or Schneider EcoStruxure Control Expert.
* Python programming, data analysis, Machine Learning, and AI techniques for process optimisation and performance monitoring.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Automation and Controls (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

  

**Additional Information**  

Job closing date: **18\.10\.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**


Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.


Working hours: 40 hours per week


Job flexibility: Fully Onsite


Target start date: 01\-February\-2027


This position involves:

* Work in Radiation Areas.
* Interventions in underground installations.
* A valid driving licence.


Job reference: EN\-CV\-CL\-2026\-230\-GRAE


Field of work: Electrical Engineering


Benchmark job: 200020 \- Computing Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On\-the\-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN \- Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**


At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.


Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.


If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

**More information about us, here:** **careers.cern**

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Remarketing
jobs.description:
**About Us**


At **Nextlane**, we don’t just develop software solutions – we **create the future** of the automotive industry.


We are a company that combines **advanced technology** with a clear vision: **simplifying and digitizing** every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.


We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to **develop** and contribute to meaningful solutions.


So… What does it mean to be a \#Nextlaner?

* Be part of a **growth\-oriented culture**.
* Collaborate with **colleagues from all over the world.**
* Believe in **the Power of ideas** and the **diversity of thought**.
* Be committed to provide an environment where you can **learn, grow, and collaborate** on projects that make a global impact.


Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.


At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to **innovate**, **push boundaries**, and **work on solutions that are transforming** the automotive world.

**Your Responsibilities:**


As Engineering Manager for Remarketing, you will lead an multidisciplinary engineering team of approximately eight people, potentially organized across multiple delivery streams responsible for a complex portfolio of customer\-facing mobile and web applications, backend services, integrations, quality capabilities, and AI\-enabled image\-processing workflows. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will be accountable for team development, engineering execution, delivery predictability, quality, and technical sustainability.


You will partner closely with Product, the Technical Lead, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Customer Success, Professional Services, and other engineering teams. Product owns the vision, roadmap, and the what and why; you own engineering capacity, delivery planning, and feasible execution of the when and how. You will challenge incomplete requirements, ensure work is ready before commitment, and make risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs transparent.


This is a technically credible leadership role rather than a full\-time coding position. You must be able to review designs, challenge architectural decisions, guide engineers and the Technical Lead, and enter the code or production diagnostics when necessary.


This role requires a change\-oriented leader who can improve the operating model while maintaining delivery and production continuity across a complex product landscape.

**What We're Looking For:**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


Team Leadership and Development

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing multidisciplinary team of approximately eight people, including internal engineers and external contributors.
* Conduct regular one\-to\-one meetings, provide timely feedback, manage performance, and create career\-development plans.
* Own hiring, onboarding, capability planning, career development, continuity planning for critical roles, and recommendations related to progression.
* Strengthen the Technical Lead role and clarify accountability across Engineering, Product, and QA.
* Foster ownership, collaboration, psychological safety, continuous learning, and constructive challenge.
**Delivery Ownership and Predictability**

* Be accountable for engineering execution and delivery predictability across the Remarketing scope.
* Translate roadmap priorities into realistic delivery plans based on capacity, dependencies, risks, technical constraints, and operational workload.
* Provide high\-level estimates and estimated delivery dates, revising them transparently as scope or evidence changes.
* Own sprint planning, execution control, reviews, retrospectives, refinement facilitation, capacity planning, and continuous improvement.
* Protect the team from uncontrolled scope changes and ad hoc requests, ensuring accepted work is visible, prioritized, and traceable in Jira.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies, release readiness, and scope\-versus\-timeline trade\-offs.
* Use engineering and delivery metrics to reduce carry\-over, improve flow, and communicate progress and risk.
**Product and Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Operate under a clear model: Product defines the what and why; Engineering owns feasible execution of the when and how.
* Challenge unclear requirements and ensure initiatives meet agreed Definition of Ready standards before commitment.
* Contribute engineering input to discovery, functional analyses, RFCs, roadmap feasibility, non\-functional requirements, and sequencing.
* Partner with Product to ensure that roadmap items are translated into delivery\-ready epics, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and intended outcomes, before Engineering commits to execution.
* Work with Customer Success, Professional Services, PMO, Sales, and Support through agreed channels and explicit ownership boundaries.
* Participate in customer interactions only exceptionally, primarily for critical technical escalations.
**Quality, SDLC and Operational Excellence**

* Drive a disciplined and traceable SDLC, with Jira as the source of truth for engineering execution.
* Establish and enforce Definitions of Ready and Done, release criteria, quality gates, and consistent issue\-type usage.
* Ensure that the team implements an appropriate automated\-testing strategy across the relevant test levels, in partnership with the Technical Lead and QA.
* Be accountable for integrating security, reliability, observability, performance, and operability into engineering planning and execution, in collaboration with the relevant specialist teams.
* Own engineering participation in incident response, root\-cause analysis, bug triage, corrective actions, and post\-release monitoring.
* Balance roadmap delivery, defects, operational support, technical debt, and modernization.
**Technical Leadership and Modernization**

* Review solution designs, challenge architectural choices, and guide decisions with the Technical Lead and Architecture.
* Provide organizational leadership for modernization initiatives, partnering with the Technical Lead and Architecture on technical direction and execution.
* Ensure that technical decisions across distributed systems, APIs, mobile and web applications, data stores, integrations, and asynchronous workflows are appropriately reviewed and owned.
* Champion SOLID principles, clean and modular architectures, pragmatic domain\-driven design, secure engineering, and useful documentation.
* Ensure technical debt is understood, connected to business impact, and transparently discussed with Product.
* Support the responsible integration of AI\-enabled capabilities and external AI services without requiring specialist model\-development expertise.
**Cloud, DevOps and Production Operations**

* Lead the team in operating cloud workloads, preferably on AWS, with sound decisions on scalability, resilience, security, cost, and service ownership.
* Drive effective CI/CD, infrastructure automation, release management, environment strategy, and rollback practices.
* Use logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service\-level indicators to improve system health.
* Ensure services and integrations meet the availability, resilience, recovery, security, and documentation requirements appropriate to their business criticality.
**SKILLS**

**Leadership and Delivery**

* Strong people management, coaching, hiring, performance management, conflict resolution, and stakeholder communication.
* Proven ability to develop senior engineers and Technical Leads and manage mixed internal and external teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery, capacity planning, dependencies, release planning, and risk management.
* Ability to create clarity and make difficult scope, capacity, and priority trade\-offs.
* Strong command of Agile and lean principles without treating ceremonies as a substitute for outcomes.
* Business\-oriented mindset connecting technical decisions to customer value, quality, cost, and operational impact.
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong software\-engineering foundation and recent experience leading distributed, customer\-facing cloud systems.
* Experience with architecture and modernization across APIs, backend services, web and mobile applications, databases, and integrations.
* Strong experience operating cloud workloads, preferably on AWS, combined with practical knowledge of containers, CI/CD, observability, security, reliability, and production operations.
* Technology\-stack agnostic, with the ability to lead environments that may include .NET, React/Next.js, Flutter, and legacy technologies.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, quality gates, secure SDLC practices, and maintainable software design.
* Ability to lead a team integrating AI\-enabled capabilities and external AI services, without requiring specialist model\-development expertise.
**Language and Soft Skills**

* Fluent English is mandatory; French is a plus.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
* High ownership, sound judgement, and effectiveness under ambiguity.
* Constructive assertiveness and confidence to challenge unrealistic commitments or incomplete inputs.
* Collaborative leadership with strong negotiation and cross\-functional skills.
**EXPERIENCE**

* A minimum of 8 years in software engineering, including at least 3 years in engineering management or an equivalent leadership role.
* Proven experience managing and developing multidisciplinary software\-engineering teams.
* Demonstrated success delivering and operating complex SaaS or cloud\-based products in production.
* Experience leading modernization, legacy reduction, or platform evolution while continuing to deliver customer value.
* Experience improving software quality, SDLC discipline, automated testing, release governance, and operational reliability.
* Strong cloud and modern DevOps experience; AWS experience is preferred.
* Experience managing customer\-impacting incidents, cross\-team dependencies, and critical technical escalations.
* Experience in automotive software, digital marketplaces, image processing, mobile products, or AI\-enabled products is advantageous but not required.
**COLLABORATION AND LEADERSHIP**


You will operate as the engineering owner for the Remarketing domain, partnering with Product on roadmap execution while maintaining clear accountability for engineering capacity, delivery, quality, technical sustainability, and team development. Success requires a builder and change\-agent mindset: creating clarity, strengthening ownership, improving the operating model, and helping the team deliver valuable outcomes with greater predictability and confidence.

**Our Recruitment Process:**

* **15\-minute introductory call** with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
* Interview with Engineering Director
* Interview with Product Director.

**What We Offer:**


We understand that **flexibility and trust** are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* **Remote Work:** Up to 3 days a week!
* **Work\-life balance:** We have flexible entrance and departure time.
* **Summer schedule on Fridays:** Start early your weekends!
* **Referral Bonus:** €1500 for every talent you refer (after 6 months).
* **Flexible Remuneration:** COBEE platform.
* **️ Private Medical Insurance:** Adeslas.
* **Continuous Learning:** Access to our internal platform for continuous development.
* **Vacation:** 23 vacation days plus an intensive schedule in July and August.
* **Teambuilding:** Our afterworks and activities are memorable!

**Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging**


At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where **everyone feels valued and respected**. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

* **Support for people with disabilities.** If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.
* **Equal opportunities for all:** We welcome applications regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Join **Nextlane** and become part of the technological revolution in the automotive industry.


Discover why we are a great place to develop your talent!

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
At **Naphora Games Group**, we're building more than games, we're building a global team of ambitious, driven people who are hungry to learn, experiment, and raise the bar for the next generation of games.



We collaborate openly, move fast, and challenge ourselves every day to build better, smarter, and faster.



Our goal is to create world\-class games that players around the globe love and remember. If you thrive in a high\-performance, ownership\-driven environment and want to make a real impact, you'll fit right in with us.

### **Role Summary**



We're looking for a **Senior Backend Engineer to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group** and help us design, build, operate, and scale robust backend systems and platforms.



You'll work hands\-on with backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, and production systems, helping us build reliable and scalable solutions that can support large user bases and growing workloads.



You'll work closely with Engineering, Product, BI, and other teams, contributing to architecture and technical decision\-making while supporting systems throughout their lifecycle, from development through production and live operations.



You'll also work with modern AI services and APIs, integrating AI models and AI\-powered capabilities into our backend systems and products.


### **Responsibilities**


**Backend Development \& Architecture**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems, services, and APIs
* Contribute to system architecture and long\-term technical decisions
* Build service layers and reusable components that can support multiple products and use cases
* Design and optimize database schemas, queries, indexing, and data models
* Build asynchronous systems using queues, workers, scheduled jobs, and event\-driven workflows
* Develop and maintain integrations with external platforms, APIs, and third\-party services


**Scale, Reliability \& Live Operations**


* Design systems capable of supporting high traffic, large user bases, and growing workloads
* Support systems throughout their lifecycle, from development to production and live operations
* Improve backend performance, reliability, security, and maintainability
* Identify technical bottlenecks and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, error handling, and system health tracking
* Investigate and resolve production incidents, performance issues, database bottlenecks, and service degradation


**AI \& Integrations**


* Integrate AI models, tools, and APIs into existing products and backend workflows
* Build reliable interfaces between backend systems and external AI providers
* Design end\-to\-end AI\-enabled workflows connecting AI services with databases, APIs, backend systems, and product logic
* Evaluate opportunities to use AI to improve product capabilities, workflows, and automation


**Collaboration \& Engineering Practices**


* Work closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Infrastructure, and other functions to deliver new features and products
* Participate in technical planning, architecture reviews, and code reviews
* Communicate technical risks, trade\-offs, and solutions clearly
* Contribute to improving engineering practices, system maintainability, and overall technical quality

### **Success Looks Like**


* Building reliable and scalable backend systems that perform effectively as our products and user base grow
* Designing backend services and APIs that are maintainable, reusable, and able to support multiple products
* Maintaining strong system reliability, performance, and uptime in live production environments
* Identifying and resolving production issues, bottlenecks, and scaling challenges effectively
* Building practical AI integrations and workflows that add value to our products and internal systems
* Making thoughtful technical and architectural decisions that support both immediate and long\-term needs
* Contributing to stronger engineering practices, monitoring, reliability, and operational processes
* Collaborating effectively across technical and product teams

### **Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, or equivalent hands\-on experience building complex production systems
* Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining backend systems in production
* Proven experience working on live systems, products, or platforms serving a large number of users
* Experience operating or supporting production environments as part of LiveOps, platform operations, or continuous product operations
* Hands\-on experience integrating AI tools, models, LLMs, or AI APIs into production systems and building practical solutions on top of them
* Ability to design and implement end\-to\-end AI\-enabled workflows connecting AI services with backend systems, databases, APIs, and product logic
* Strong understanding of backend architecture, distributed systems, API design, databases, caching, concurrency, scalability, performance optimization, and system reliability
* Strong experience with at least one backend language or framework such as Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, Java, or C\#
* Strong SQL and database design experience, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar relational databases
* Experience building REST APIs and service\-based architectures
* Experience with Redis or similar caching technologies
* Experience with message queues, workers, or event\-driven systems
